content: {"paper_id":"W2123217057","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"multi-label-learning","exact_quote":"Multi-label Classification Using Ensembles of Pruned Sets","evidence_field":"title","reason_zh":"标题明确指出研究任务是多标记分类，摘要也说明该pruned sets方法用于multi-label classification，满足定义。"},{"keyword_id":"label-correlation-modeling","exact_quote":"This allows the classification process to inherently take into account correlations between labels.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要说明把标签集合视为单一标签从而显式考虑标签间相关性，并进一步剪枝聚焦最重要相关性，属于显式建模标签相关结构。"},{"keyword_id":"classifier-ensemble","exact_quote":"By combining pruned sets in an ensemble scheme (EPS), new label sets can be formed to adapt to irregular or complex data.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"EPS以集成方案组合多个pruned sets分类器来完成多标记分类，符合结合多个分类器预测的分类器集成定义。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
